result.description: Morrow Quanta S11 is a compact consumer storage device designed for fast project transfer, scratch-space use, and laptop expansion. It uses a PCIe NVMe interface in a USB-C enclosure, offering quick read/write access for media files, game libraries, and backup workflows. The S11 balances speed, portability, and quiet operation in a slim anodized shell.
result.title: Morrow Quanta S11 512 GB PCIe NVMe Portable Cache
